connection.notFound: That Meta connection isn't in this workspace.

connection.gone.message: {name} is disconnected. Connect Meta again to collect leads.
connection.gone.note: name: the connection's name, such as Acme Marketing

connection.exists: This workspace is connected to Meta already ({name}). Open it to add Pages.
name.missing: Give the connection a name, such as your business's.
token.rejected: Meta refused the token. Generate the system user's token again and paste it.
token.expired: Meta refused the token: it expired. Generate one with no expiry and paste it again.

token.permissions.message: The token lacks a permission ReputeCast needs. Generate it again with {permissions}.
token.permissions.note: permissions: Meta's permission names, never translated

token.noPages: The token can't see any Page. Give the system user your Pages in Business Settings.
app.rejected: Meta didn't accept this app ID and secret together. Copy both from App settings › Basic.
app.secretWithId: Paste the new app's secret too.
meta.unavailable: Meta didn't answer. Try again in a few minutes.
meta.rateLimited: Meta asked ReputeCast to slow down. Try again in 15 minutes.
page.unknown: The token doesn't reach one of those Pages any more. Reload the list and choose again.

page.subscribeFailed.message: Meta didn't subscribe the app to {page}'s leads. Check that the system user can manage the Page, then try again.

page.notChosen: {page} isn't chosen any more. Choose it again to import its leads.
form.notFound: That lead form isn't in this workspace.

form.notMapped.message: Map {form} first: choose which question is the email address, and its lists.

import.paused: {form} is paused. Resume it to import its past leads.
import.running: Leads from {form} are being imported already.

mapping.question.message: {key} isn't one of the form's questions. Reload the form and map it again.
mapping.question.note: key: a question's key in Meta, such as full_name

mapping.target: Pick a contact field or a custom field for each question you keep.

mapping.twice.message: {first} and {second} are saved in the same field. Keep one of them.

mapping.email: Choose which question is the email address.
mapping.names: Use First and last name, or First name and Last name, not both.
mapping.list: Pick at least one of the workspace's lists.
mapping.listScope: You can't add contacts to {list}. Pick a list you have access to.
consent.noCheckbox: This form has no consent checkbox. Add one under Custom disclaimer in Meta to use single opt-in.
consent.pick: Choose the checkbox that is the consent to email.
notify.title: Meta refused the lead ads token

notify.body.message: Leads from {name} wait at Meta until a new token is pasted.

note.lead.note: a consent record's note; form: the lead form's name
